fields.headline: Starfall Legends
fields.subheadline: Gather your party and chase the falling stars. A hand-drawn action-RPG set across the floating isles of Auralis, where every comet leaves behind a creature to befriend — or battle.
fields.summary: Master the Starbind combat system, evolve your companions through dozens of forms, and uncover who shattered the night sky. Couch co-op for up to four heroes.
